title: Wren and the Horizon
author: Coral Thornbury
blurb: August Whitlock, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
